objective: Freeze the executable service-catalog authority split before retiring browser-owned drafts and lifecycle mutations.
frozenFindings: services-repository writes every save to localStorage before attempting the remote mutation
remote write failure returns a pending local copy instead of failing closed
load merges local drafts with remote rows and attempts background synchronization
getById can return an owner-readable local service when remote authority is absent or fails
owner pause, reactivate, archive and edit operations route through repository.update and inherit the hybrid save boundary
review submission and administrative moderation already use authenticated server boundaries
public visibility is restricted to approved or safely preserved approved versions

blockers.reason: Local service drafts and remote published versions coexist without a final promotion contract.
Historical orders need immutable service snapshots across every creation path.
